incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High error rate on /v1/embeddings/search for prod-cluster-2. 5xx spike, N=1200 in last 10m. Paging SRE oncall. link: https://ops.redwood/alerts/INC-1718004321
Maya (oncall): on it. joining bridge now. can someone confirm customer-facing impact?
Emily (support): seeing >=3 active tickets from customers (acct: acme-data, acct: finlabs). Users report search returning 502s and timeouts. EM: high severity for acme-data (SLAs).
Jon (infra): looking at router logs — lots of fallback retries. sample: `route_request id=0x7f3 model_alias=search-embed alias_target=search-embed:v2024-09 metadata.variant=chat_instruct-4x status=INCOMPATIBLE -> fallback to gen-compat`
Jon (infra): Also seeing repeated region fallback: eu-west -> us-east -> eu-west, which is causing amplification.
Ravi (mlops): quick summary: yesterday's alias rollout (search-embed alias) updated to a model digest that is a chat-instruct variant. That model lacks the embeddings hook so the runtime triggers an automatic fallback to a gen-compatible path, which then returns 5xx for embedding requests. I can repro with a curl:```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"search-embed","input":"test"}' | jq
# -> 500 error, runtime log shows: "model variant mismatch: expected embedding pipeline, got chat_instruct"```
Maya (oncall): ok — cause understood. Ravi/Jon, can we stop the alias at the router-level or pin to previous digest? We need fast mitigation before rollback completes.
Jon (infra): I can add a policy rule to reject requests routed to models whose capability != embeddings. Pushing a temporary routing predicate now (will add allowlist). Command: ```
POST /admin/routing/policy
{
  "alias": "search-embed",
  "predicate": "capability == 'embeddings'",
  "action": "allow"
}
```
Jon (infra): applying rule... applied.
Maya (oncall): monitoring metrics.
Emily (support): acme-data tickets updated — told them we're investigating and routing mitigations are in progress. They reported partial recovery for some calls.
Ravi (mlops): I'll perform alias rollback to previous digest (sha256:8f3a1b2). Running: ```
redwoodctl alias set --name search-embed --digest sha256:8f3a1b2 --force
```
Ravi (mlops): rollback queued and deployed to control plane at 1718005160.
Maya (oncall): error rate dropping but still some residual fails due to cached routes. Jon, can we evict router cache?
Jon (infra): evicting prefix cache on prod-cluster-2 now: `routerctl cache flush --prefix search-embed --cluster prod-cluster-2`
Jon (infra): cache flush done.
Maya (oncall): metrics: error rate 35% -> 4% in 12 minutes after rollback+policy+cache flush. latency back to baseline for embeddings.
Emily (support): sent customer follow-ups to acme-data and finlabs with ETA for full resolution. They want a postmortem.
Alex (product): noted. We'll prepare a customer-facing summary once RCA is complete.
Danny (sre): created incident ticket INC-1718004321 in Jira and linked runbook. Initial severity P2 -> lowered to P3 after containment and customer impact limited to partial failures.
Ravi (mlops): root cause: alias rollout automation didn't validate capability tag (chat vs embed). The release pipeline allowed updating alias to a model with mismatched capability.
Ravi (mlops): proposed immediate actions: 1) gate alias updates with capability invariant check; 2) add preflight test that runs a tiny embedding call during canary; 3) alert when alias changes and capability differs.
Jon (infra): infra follow-ups: 1) make router predicate rules able to auto-protect incompatible capability changes; 2) fix cache invalidation race during rollback.
Maya (oncall): operational notes: bridge/handed off to oncall at 1718005880. final mitigation at 1718006160. closing monitoring window at 1718008521.
Danny (sre): action items assigned: Ravi -> gate + preflight; Jon -> router predicate and cache fix; Emily -> customer comms draft; Alex -> coordinate external summary.
Maya (oncall): thanks team. good job on rapid rollback and routing guard. filing for full postmortem. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC-1718004321 status: RESOLVED. summary: alias rollout introduced chat variant behind `search-embed` alias causing embedding requests to fallback and error. Mitigations: temporary routing predicate, alias rollback to sha256:8f3a1b2, cache flush. Postmortem assigned.
